parts:
Dear all, 

I have what I think is a simple question. However, I can't seem to find a simple answer. I have the following code;

inla.formula = "yVar ~ -1 + x2002 + x2003 + x2004 + x2005 + x2006 + x2007 + x2008 +
                       x2009 + x2010 + x2011 + x2012 + x2013 + x2014 + x2015 +
                       x2016 + x2017 + x2018 + x2019 +
                       f(Kcluster, age, model = \"besag\", graph = W, constr = FALSE)"
mod          = inla(as.formula(inla.formula), family="gaussian", data = myData,
               control.compute = list(waic = TRUE) )


In my model the parameter age (of properties) is spatially smoothed via a Besag model. Here is the thing. I sometimes find a positive estimate for age, which should be impossible. Thus the only constraint I want to add is that the upper boundary of this parameter is less than zero.

Many thanks and kind regards,
Alex
